title: Affine evaluation of the higher-image limit cocone
statement: Let Λ be any commutative ring, k:W→S and G a Λ-module sheaf on W_et [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let I be a small cofiltered category and D:I→Over W have affine transition morphisms and qcqs structure maps to S. Let c be a cone whose underlying cone of schemes is limiting, with qcqs structure map to S. Fix q∈ℤ. Let K:I^op→Sh(S_et,Λ) be presented by isomorphisms eK_i:K(i)≅R^qg_i,*G_i, where g_i:D(i)→S and G_i=D(i)^*G, and require its arrows to be eK_i≫t(D(f))≫eK_j^-1, for the canonical transitions of [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions]. Let B be a cocone presented by eB:B.pt≅R^qg_*G_c and legs eK_i≫t(c_i)≫eB^-1. For every affine etale object V→S, evaluation of B on V is a colimit cocone in Λ-modules. Inverse images and higher direct images are as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

source.place: Tag 09Z1, proof steps on qcqs etale objects; Tags 03Q8, 09YQ, 0EZM, 03FD, 0738(4)

proof.text: Use affine-section class descent for the actual limit higher image. Map a section of B.pt across eB, descend it to a stage, and map its representative back across eK_i. The displayed hB equation and inverse-isomorphism cancellation show that the resulting B coprojection sends it to the original section.

For two same-stage sections whose B images coincide, their difference has zero B image. Apply eB and use hB to obtain zero canonical limit image for the difference transported by eK_i. Affine-section eventual vanishing supplies f:j→i killing this transported difference. Use hK and eK_j inverse to conclude equality of the two transitioned K sections.

Mathlib Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' constructs the colimit from joint surjectivity and eventual equality at a common stage. Forgetting modules preserves filtered colimits (ModuleCat.FilteredColimits) and reflects isomorphisms, hence reflects this colimit. Apply isColimitOfReflects to obtain the displayed module-cocone colimit.
